ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   C. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru.
   B. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.
   B. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..
   D. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

11. Which response best shows understanding of Wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wudhu.
   B. Say Wudhu has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Swalah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Kindness to Allah’s Creatures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Manners of Dressing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Positive Usage of Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pillars of Swalah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic Manners of Dressing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Positive Usage of Media; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
